text.EN: That's a lot of them. Stay sharp.
We've got a whole crowd moving in. Eyes open.
text.TL: May malaking grupo na paparating. Magmatyag.
May kuyog! Tignan ang mga labasan.

text.EN: Too many bodies out there. Watch the perimeter.
text.TL: Masyado silang marami sa labas. Bantayan ang paligid.

text.EN: They're grouping up. Form a line.
Sound drew a swarm. Get ready.
text.TL: Nakaakit ng kuyog ang ingay. Humanda.

text.EN: Look at that herd. Stay close.
text.TL: Tingnan mo ang kawan na 'yan. Dumikit ka.

text.EN: Mass contacts coming from down the street.
Here they come. Don't let them flank us.
text.TL: Heto na sila. Huwag silang hayaang pumaligid.

text.EN: Big group incoming. Watch each other's backs.
text.TL: Malaking grupo ang dumarating. Bantayan ang likod ng bawat isa.
